description.text: The other BW3 expansion, released on 16 September 2011 alongside Psycho Drive, in which Pokémon-EX made their debut: cards with overwhelming HP and damage, unrelated to the older Pokémon ex. Its Pokémon-EX are Kyurem-EX, Groudon-EX and Regigigas-EX. Both packs are set in Castelia City, the heart of Unova, and from here Pokémon from every region returned to the BW series. Its Ultra Rares are shiny Emboar and Chandelure. The cards are numbered to 52. In English most of them came out in Next Destinies in February 2012, and Groudon-EX in Dark Explorers in May 2012.
